images.author: Helen E. Grose
images.why: Documented mature wild bull on Nunavik tundra, Canada; imposing horns and shaggy coat against autumn vegetation. Original-file URL; resolution and download could not be independently verified.

images.author: Lasse Kyed
images.why: Photographer identifies this as a large wild bull near Kangerlussuaq, Greenland. Geographic match, but the available linked version is only 1024×768, below the preferred resolution.

images.author: Coke Smith
images.why: Single wild lowland bongo crossing Dzanga Bai, Central African Republic; chestnut coat, thin pale stripes and spiralled horns. Source states photographs are copyrighted; sex and native resolution unverified.

images.author: Coke Smith
images.why: Solitary lowland bongo standing alert beside a fallen log in a natural forest clearing. Strong species markings and an isolated subject; copyrighted source, sex and native resolution unverified.

images.author: Coke Smith
images.why: Alternative walking pose of a wild lowland bongo at Dzanga Bai, with reddish coat, stripes and horns visible. Copyrighted source; sex, native resolution and final crop suitability unverified.

images.author: George Brits
images.why: Two zebras in golden grass at Mountain Zebra National Park, South Africa; attractive warm habitat colour. A 3000px delivery URL; assess the near-square crop to retain a complete animal.

images.author: Colin Watts
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies mountain zebras in Namibia. Wild group in open habitat; geographic match, though less suited to a single-animal card. A 3000px delivery URL.

images.author: Dean Erasmus
images.why: Explicitly identified as Cape mountain zebra, Equus zebra zebra, at De Hoop Nature Reserve. Natural grazing scene with hills; heads lowered rather than an alert portrait. A 3000px delivery URL.
